audit.title: Speech by Chairman Bernanke on communication and monetary policy - Federal Reserve Board

events.quote: monetary policy as transparent and open as reasonably possible
responding to the financial crisis and its aftermath soon became the Federal Reserve's main focus
enhanced transparency is increasing the effectiveness of monetary policy
The public's expectations about future monetary policy actions matter today because those expectations have important effects on current financial conditions
the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) has clarified the Federal Reserve's objectives and policy strategy
The financial crisis and its aftermath, however, have raised even greater challenges for, and demands on, the Federal Reserve's communication.
The so-called zero lower bound on the FOMC's policy interest rate was not the only challenge the Committee faced.
the federal funds rate should be set well below zero, which, of course, was not feasible.
Crossing one of the thresholds will not automatically give rise to an increase in the federal funds rate target
the unemployment rate--which, despite some drawbacks in this regard, is probably the best single summary indicator of the state of the labor market
it became clear early on that more monetary accommodation would be needed than could be provided through the management of short-term rates alone
the FOMC reduced its target for the federal funds rate close to zero
it began supplementing its rate policies and forward rate guidance with large-scale asset purchases (LSAPs)
the use of these tools allows monetary policy to be effective even when short-term interest rates are close to zero
we are somewhat less certain about the magnitudes of the effects on financial conditions and the economy of changes in the pace of purchases
market participants may have taken the communication in June as indicating a general lessening of the Committee's commitment to maintain a highly accommodative stance of policy in
The FOMC applied the framework communicated in June.
longer-term rates fell and expectations of short-term rates derived from financial market prices showed, and continue to show, a pattern more consistent with the guidance.
the unemployment rate has fallen 0.8 percentage point
about 2.6 million payroll jobs have been added
the FOMC still expects that labor market conditions will continue to improve
The Fed's monetary policy communications have proved far more important and have evolved in different ways than I would have envisioned eight years ago.
The FOMC remains committed to maintaining highly accommodative policies for as long as they are needed.

events.quote: The Effects of the Federal Reserve's Date-Based Forward Guidance
the Committee anticipates that its 0 to 1/4 percent target range for the federal funds rate will be appropriate at least as long as the unemployment rate remains above 6-1/2
interest rates should fall and asset prices should rise, thus easing financial conditions
LSAPs may affect financial conditions through other channels as well
the Fed has remitted more than $350 billion to the Treasury, about the same total as it remitted during the 18 years prior to the crisis
